problem: Native Word RTF section geometry lost document margin defaults, sectdefaultcl incorrectly reset a two-column section, and a section break inside an ordinary formatting group disappeared from the body events. Native note edits rejected balanced fcs formatting groups, and section edits could select the wrong source region when breaks were grouped or inherited.
changes: Separate document paper/margin/orientation controls from per-section controls. Retain document defaults and section override masks, restoring document geometry on sectd. Resolve unoverridden geometry once after parsing so repeated global controls do not repeatedly walk all prior sections.

Interpret sectdefaultcl as an explicit default document-grid marker, preserving columns and line pitch. Correct SectionDocumentGridType::Default serialization to sectdefaultcl and add SnapToGrid for the specification's literal sectspecifygenN, retaining sectspecifygen as an input alias.

Record main-story section breaks inside ordinary formatting groups and bind the next retained section definition. Non-body destinations cannot reset body section state; section breaks in table cells are refused.

Locate section-value edits through semantic section-definition identity and visible source boundaries, including inherited sections without their own definition. Destination groups remain excluded and count mismatches fail closed.

Admit fcs as character formatting only inside balanced selected groups for exact destination splicing. Retain conservative handling of state-changing controls outside those groups; existing clean-document canonical fallback remains separate.

Add nine native regressions and seven synthetic tests, update the existing grid expectations from source/spec evidence, and bind four previously unasserted RTF rows without changing historical native-evidence labels.

verification_scope.geometry: word-tables-layout.rtf exposes portrait12240x15840 and landscape15840x12240 with all document margins1440, two landscape columns, line pitch360 and explicit default grid. One grouped sect boundary binds section1 at the exact main-story position after Second section begins below. Document-default reset, explicit overrides, late root updates, inert headers and canonical geometry round trips have synthetic coverage.
verification_scope.headers: Three physical section0 stories retain HeaderRight HEADER_DEFAULT_002 plus its empty paragraph, FooterLeft empty text and FooterRight FOOTER_PAGE_002. Two footer PAGE fields retain cached empty/2 results and exact story references. Section1 has no newly authored header/footer definitions; inherited rendering is not inferred.
verification_scope.notes: The table-layout source has one endnote with ENDNOTE_TEXT_002; layout-extensions has one footnote with FOOTNOTE_COLUMN_016. Exact text, foot/end kind, default reference placeholders, main-story anchor and note-kind/placement flags are tested. Four separator destinations contain the exact separator/continuation marker plus paragraph-break sequence. Marker wording does not qualify footnote-area columns.
verification_scope.policies: The minimal native RTF preserves PageLayout view100%, zero gutter, legacy footnote layout, validatexml1, note-kind/placement flags, effective section properties and body text through actual model writing. These controls remain passive metadata.
verification_scope.pages: Visual-object and vector-diagram sources expose exact page-break byte positions [96,115] and [75,97], with no explicit column/soft breaks. Source reopen preserves event order. Model writing of the visual-object source preserves the full body-event order, positions and text; the vector source retains its separately qualified structural-opaque writer boundary.
verification_scope.edits: A running-header replacement is exactly one source-text substitution. Footnote/endnote edits preserve every byte outside their selected groups, all chftn markers, note identity, main text and sections through temporary save/reopen. The landscape edit changes exactly cols2 to cols3 and inserts marglsxn1000 at section1, leaving section0 and auxiliary stories intact. All edit inverses restore the original RTF bytes.
verification_scope.limitations: No Word reopen, pagination, rendering, shaping, page/note-number evaluation, field refresh or active content execution. General policy/section lifecycle, full rich note editing and footnote-area columns remain unqualified. Existing source-splice versus canonical-publication boundaries are retained.
